commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+2' Substitution. Nicolas Hofler walks off the pitch and Florent Muslija (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' Christian Streich has decided to substitute Christian Gunter and he is replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Lucas Holer is given a rest as he is replaced by Junior Adamu (Freiburg).
90+1' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) takes a short corner kick.

90+1' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' B. Monchengladbach enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
86' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
85' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
85' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
85' There's an opportunity for Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
84' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

84' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
83' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from B. Monchengladbach was in an offside position.
80' The attendance is 53259.

79' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
79' B. Monchengladbach spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
78' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
77' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
77' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

75' The manager makes a subsitution with Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Joe Scally.

75' Christian Streich prepares a substitution. Yannik Keitel is replaced by Attila Szalai (Freiburg).
74' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
71' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) watches the cross in from Franck Honorat, but plants his header from the edge of the six-yard box well wide of the left post.
70' Substitution. Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) has come on for Nico Elvedi.
68' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
65' The current number of shots on goal is 3:8.
64' B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
62' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
61' Substitution. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Robin Hack walks off.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jordan Siebatcheu departs the field of play to be replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
61' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Florian Neuhaus.
61' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
59' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick.

57' 0 - 3 GOAL! Superb work from Maximilian Eggestein, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Ritsu Doan (Freiburg), who beats Jonas Omlin with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 0:3.
57' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
56' A lofted cross from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
54' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
52' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
49' B. Monchengladbach hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
47' 0 - 2 Goal! Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
47' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Jonas Omlin pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
47' Some neat passing and movement from Freiburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
45+1' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' Some great controlled play and passing from Freiburg. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
42' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
39' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
39' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) is penalised for holding. Christian Dingert signals a set piece.
37' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the left post.
35' Lucas Holer (Freiburg) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Jonas Omlin is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
33' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
32' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
31' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
31' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
30' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) commits a rough challenge and Christian Dingert blows his whistle for an infringement.
29' It's a throw-in for B. Monchengladbach.
26' A long pass finds Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
26' The B. Monchengladbach players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

24' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) goes on a great individual run, arrives at the edge of the box and pulls the trigger. It was a promising effort which would have most likely gone past the goalkeeper if it hadn't been deflected by another offensive player.
23' Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
22' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) will take a corner kick.
21' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

19' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jonas Omlin has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
16' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) hits a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.

14' B. Monchengladbach hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
12' The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner.

12' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
10' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
7' 0 - 1 Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.

6' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
4' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) launches a cross from the corner, but Noah Atubolu is alert to thwart the effort.
2' Good team movement sets up Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
